eps.o: Kayce goes rogue in a desperate race to save his son as the Marshals uncover a powerful criminal operation tied to the East Camp land grab. A violent showdown ensues, putting everything Kayce cares about at risk.
An ex-cop launches a killing spree with the Marshals in his crosshairs.
The Marshals investigate a military drone explosion on Broken Rock.
The Marshals hunt for a fugitive bomber before he can strike again.
The Marshals hunt for a bomber armed with a massive explosive.
With Cal away in Utah seeing a cancer specialist, Andrea steps up as team leader and is instantly tested when Kayce ventures outside Marshals jurisdiction to help Mo track down his missing nephew.
Kayce and Belle go undercover inside a dangerous cult, led by the manipulative Eric Savard, to find a missing federal agent who has gone dark after infiltrating the group.

Tasked with wrangling an international fugitive, the Marshals find themselves in the middle of a diamond heist shootout. Kayce and Cal, both reeling from recent fallout with their children, take different approaches to coping.
